torrents.introduction:
曾经、魔法少女和邪恶相互为敌。 / Katsute Mahou Shoujo to Aku wa Tekitai shiteita. / かつて魔法少女と悪は敵対していた。 BDRip

本片改编自藤原可可亚的遗作，由 BONES 制作。整体画质没有大的问题，主要是原生 720p 带来的一系列通病：画面偏糊、噪点较重、锯齿明显，另有轻微振铃。松竹发行的这版 BD 编码质量也不理想，码率偏低，画面存在欠码。好在重噪起到了一定的保护作用，没有出现明显色带，仅部分场景蚊噪较多。
考虑到重噪是本片风格的重要组成部分，我们予以保留，其余处理以针对线条和欠码的常规手段为主，不再赘述。ED 部分包含大量 FHD 素材，噪点风格较正片更为强烈；我们在维持观感的前提下调整了噪点层，将码率控制在适中水平。
This release is adapted from Kokoa Fujiwara's posthumous work and produced by BONES. The overall image quality has no major issues; it mainly shows the usual problems of a native 720p source: a somewhat soft image, fairly heavy grain, and obvious aliasing, plus slight ringing. The encoding quality of this BD release from Shochiku is also less than ideal; the bitrate is low, and the image suffers from insufficient bitrate. Fortunately, the heavy grain provided a degree of protection, and no obvious banding appeared, with DCT noise being heavier only in some scenes.
Considering that the heavy grain is an important part of this show's style, we kept it; the rest of the processing consisted mainly of conventional measures for lines and insufficient bitrate, which we will not elaborate on here. The ED contains a large amount of FHD material, and its grain style is stronger than that of the main feature; we adjusted the grain layer while maintaining the viewing experience, keeping the bitrate at a moderate level.
